limitations: These are selected 3 km centers inside six LROC NAC DTM products, not continuous 5 m coverage of the Moon.
Some centers overlap; tile count is not an independent-sample count.
A 5 m comparison grid may downsample 2-4 m source products and does not prove 5 m resolved geology or material identity.
Queries with missing DEM cells are rejected; site context is not a per-window landform or material label.
